edits.before: - Nilah Jubilant Veil: matchup-defining — Dodges ALL attacks while it shimmers — never auto into the veil; spells still land. Count it out loud if you must. - Your R Featherstorm has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
